corpus: zarr (self-review, top 60 of the default report)

labels.note: NumChunks and numStored compute the same ceil(shape/cell) per dimension, differing only in the divisor (a.chunks vs a.grid); one helper parameterized by cell shape suffices.

members and items share the identical container loop (open check, empty case, skipSpace, close/comma switch); only per-element handling (key+colon vs bare) differs, so a shared container scanner parameterized by delimiters is worthwhile.
Named.decode's object branch reimplements decodeObject's keyed decode (exact key match, duplicate refusal, case-fold refusal) for three fixed keys; it could call decodeObject with a field func.

decodeLimit and bound both fold bytesBound over pipeline bytes codecs from encodedBound with an overflow cutoff; decodeLimit is a prefix bound capped at maxStoredBytes, so a shared prefix-bound helper would remove the duplicated loop.
parseBytes and parseSharding (and newArray) repeat the 'decodeObject fast path else reset and json.Unmarshal' idiom, worth a shared helper, while the validation after it differs.
MemoryStore List and Keys both collect map keys under RLock and sort them; Keys is List's collection with prefix "", so a shared sortedKeys(prefix) helper removes the duplication.
byRange repeats patchesChunks' condition (shard != nil && no bytes codecs) and adds the RangeGetter check; it should call patchesChunks.
Shuffle encode/decode are inverse transposes (gather vs scatter by element size); same shape, opposite direction.
Per-codec config parsers with different fields and validation (gzip level 0-9 vs shuffle elementsize>=0); parallel 6-line builders.
Array and Group SetAttributes are the same 8 lines over different metadata types, already delegating to withAttributes and writeMetadata; Go generics cannot share the field access cleanly.
checkKey/checkPrefix are thin wrappers over validSegments differing only in the lastMayBeEmpty flag and error message.
s3 List and ListDir already share pagination via pages; ListDir adds CommonPrefixes and trims the prefix.

Both use the members-callback fast-decode driver, but Named.decode handles a Named (string form, name/configuration/must_understand) while decodeMetadata handles zarr.json with extension-field and attributes semantics.
WriteChunk and Write both delegate to exclusive/patchShard/readStored/copyBlock/writeStored; WriteChunk is the single-chunk entry with its own length check and past-end handling.
Read and Write are the region read/write pair with different concurrency and chunk handling.
Sharding EncodeArray/DecodeArray are inverse directions (extract+assemble vs split+insert).
s3 Get and GetRange share the GetObject+limited ReadAll step but GetRange carries range/suffix/HeadObject logic absent from Get.
readMetadata and mustBeNew share checkPath + Get(metadataKey) but do opposite things with the result (parse vs refuse existence).
minus (elementwise a-b) and minusOne (scalar decrement) are tiny parallel slice helpers.
gzip-style config parsers for shuffle vs zstd (separate package) with different fields and checks.
BytesCodec EncodeArray/DecodeArray are serialize/deserialize directions.
MemoryStore Set and Delete share the ctx/lock prologue but are write vs delete.
checkPath and checkPrefix are thin wrappers over validSegments with different flags (reserved, root allowed) and messages.
checkPath and checkKey are thin wrappers over validSegments with different flags and messages.
items iterates array elements; skipString scans a JSON string with escapes; only byte-scanner vocabulary shared.
decodeMetadata and decodeObject share the members-callback driver but decodeMetadata adds must_understand extensions, attributes, and format/node checks.
DirStore List walks recursively with WalkDir while ListDir reads one directory; shared ctx/walk prologue already factored.
patchShard rewrites chunks of a shard; openStored builds a chunk reader; shared shard/index vocabulary only.
fillFrom converts a Go value by reflect kind; parseFill parses JSON fill text incl. NaN/hex; different inputs and rules.
writeStored writes a whole stored object; patchShard is the per-chunk shard patch with split/assemble; they share only the fill-past/allFill/delete-or-set pattern.
DirStore Get and Delete share the ctx/path prologue but read vs remove.
minusOne and times are trivial elementwise slice helpers with different ops.
s3 Set (PutObject) and pages (ListObjectsV2 pagination) share only client/prefix vocabulary.
ReadChunk and WriteChunk are the read/write pair for one chunk.
s3 Set and Delete are put vs delete.
minus and times are trivial elementwise slice helpers with different operators.
typedChunk extract and insert are the inverse block copies.
s3 Get and Delete are read vs delete.
parseKeyEncoding and parseGzip both unmarshal JSON config but handle unrelated schemas and validation.
CreateArray and CreateGroup share mustBeNew/withAttributes/writeMetadata already factored; CreateArray's body is mostly array-specific setup.
shardOf (elementwise divide) and plus (elementwise add) are trivial parallel slice helpers.
MemoryStore Get and Set are read vs write.
members iterates object members; skipValue dispatches on value kind (and calls members); only scanner vocabulary shared.
shardOf (idx/perShard) and numStored (ceil shape/grid) are different small per-dimension computations.
parseKeyEncoding and decodeMetadataSlowly share json.Unmarshal/error vocabulary but decode unrelated structures.
newPipeline maps Named->Codec, namedCodecs maps Codec->Named; inverse conversions.
DirStore Set and Delete are write vs remove.
ShardingCodec assemble and split are the build/parse inverse of a shard layout.
Read assembles a region from chunks; resizeStored deletes/refills cut-off objects; shared eachSpan/chunk vocabulary only.
GetRange reads a byte span of one key; Keys lists sorted keys; only lock/map vocabulary shared.
getStored and writeStored are the decode-read vs encode-write of a stored object.
DirStore path maps a key to a file path; walk splits a prefix into dir/base; different jobs over shared checks.
decodeField decodes typed fields; skipValue only finds a value's end; unrelated logic.
region validates a request and computes cell bounds; overlap intersects a region with one cell; different computations over shape vocabulary.
DirStore Get and Set are read vs atomic write.
namedCodec and withAttributes both json.Marshal with a wrapped error but build unrelated values.
keyLocks lock and release are acquire vs release of a refcounted lock.
decodeField is a typed field decoder; decodeAttributes collects raw attribute values; shared scanner vocabulary only.
DimensionNames and NumChunks are unrelated small per-dimension accessors on Array.
